# 777 Neon Nights — llms.txt

> Free promo slot game for "Neon Nights Pt. 777" by That Boy Hi Hat.
> Built by Cumulative Web Inc. No gambling. No cash prizes. No purchase necessary.

## About

777 Neon Nights is a free promotional slot-machine web game for the single
"Neon Nights Pt. 777" by alternative rap artist That Boy Hi Hat
(Cumulative Web Inc). Players spin neon reels; wins award Neon Credits
(fun points with no money value) and unlock free streaming links for the
artist's catalog.

- Live game: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-777-neon-nights/
- Machine-readable content: ./content.json
- Agent card: ./agent-card.json (also /.well-known/agent-card.json)
- Owner telemetry dashboard: ./telemetry/dashboard.html

## Key facts (verified)

- Free game: spins are free and regenerate over time; nothing can be bought with money.
- Prizes: free music links (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, YouTube Music, TIDAL, Deezer, Amazon Music, Pandora, DistroKid hyperfollow allowlist) + listening prizes (phone wallpaper, art pack, Golden Reel spins).
- Neon Credits: fun points — NO money value, redeemable only for free music links.
- Not gambling: no real-money wagering, no cash prizes, prizes have no cash value.
- Prize-mode architecture: v1 = promo prizes only. A future money-prize mode is
  architecturally supported (swappable provider) but hard-gated behind gambling
  licenses, counsel opinion, KYC/AML, age verification, geo-fencing, certified
  RNG, and the owner's explicit approval — it cannot switch on without them.
- Telemetry: anonymous-only (random device id, counts, public issued-link URLs). No PII.
- i18n: 41 languages. Offline-capable PWA (service worker).
- Version: nn777-v8.5. Changelog: ./CHANGELOG.md
